name: general-library

building.title: General Library, University of Auckland
building.note: outline: building 109's outline from the main project's campus.json, in the map's frame; used only to choose the crop box, to pick the building's own points (frame.near_outline) and to draw on the heightmap figure; the frame comes from the LiDAR.

origin.note: the campus origin, as in campus.json; the landmark's local metres = NZTM (EPSG:2193) minus the NZTM of this point, with grid north

lidar.licence: Auckland Part 1 LiDAR (2024), OpenTopography NZ24_Auckland, doi:10.5069/G9HH6H8T: sourced from LINZ and licensed by Regional Software Holdings Limited for re-use under CC BY 4.0

aerial.licence: Auckland Central 0.06 m Urban Aerial Photos (2023): sourced from LINZ and licensed by Auckland Council for re-use under CC BY 4.0

frame.method: LiDAR building points (class 6) within near_outline m of building 109's outline: centre = mean x/y of points higher than tower_above m: the roof of the tower slab and the plant room on it; axis = the bearing of most of the walls seen from above (axis_from walls), the one of the two square to each other nearest the principal axis of the points from min_above to spine_below m within spine_radius m of the centre, pointing north-ish as street_side is west; toStreet = the axis turned 90 deg toward street_side: south-west, to Alfred Street.

ground_note: provisional: the LiDAR ground on Alfred Street in front of the middle of the south-west face (43.7 to 44.3 m; the site falls about 5 m from Princes Street on the west, 45.6 m, to 40.5 m on the east); set at the door once the references show it
